style: Arabic-letter-like signs with no dotted-stroke dividers: a ra-like hook (= kaf), a dal-like hook (= mim), a round ha with a tail (= the divider letter, after every word), a crossed ha / 8 with a bar (= waw at the word starts), a crossed double bar at the very start (= fa), and in l.3-4 U (= alif), mim-like stems (= lam), ٢ (= ya), ط, و-like, a sin
technique_note: 82v l.12-13: ومما كتبه لي ايضا في مدح [?] الكمال القاضي امين الدين المذكور اضمارا [?] وجعل فواصله حرفا من جنس الاشكال ('and of what he also wrote for me ... and he made its dividers a letter of the same kind as the signs'). This is visible in the block: the round ha-with-tail sign stands after each word (after فكم, كم, وكم ... and at the end), so the block has no stroke dividers but a divider letter. plaintext.text: فكم كم وكم كم [كم] وكم كم وكم وكم وكم كم وكم يا لليل هذا التناسا

plaintext.certainty: high for the words; the order of the repeated كم/وكم read on a 1x crop and confirmed by the cipher

fit_check: fits: 46 letter-signs (60 signs less 14 divider letters) vs 45 letters (47 with the small interlinear كم); 14 word groups vs 15 words. Word by word the cipher reads, with the divider letter as separator: فكم | كم | وكم | كم | وكم | كم | وكم | وكم | وكم | كم | وكم | يالليل (one group of 6, no divider) | هذا | التناسيا (8 signs: the cipher has a ya before the final alif) |. So the cipher has eleven كم-words, the same sequence as the page without the small كم written above the fourth word; the repeated 3-sign unit of l.1-2 is (divider)+كم, i.e. ك م + the divider letter, with و in front where the plaintext has وكم.
notes: Sign values from the group structure: ra-hook = kaf, dal-hook = mim, U = alif (يا, هذا, التناسيا), mim-stem = lam (لليل, التناسيا), ٢ = ya. One وكم on l.2 has a 9-like sign in the kaf place and one كم a crossed-8 variant in the kaf place (two forms of kaf, or slips).

Several line ends run on without a divider (83r l.13, 83v l.1, l.2, l.4, l.5); single signs written at the left edge of 83v l.1-4 are the line-end letters and are counted (the group pattern needs them).

technique_note: 83r l.8-12: واتفق ان امين الدين المذكور كتب قصة بامر ما فرفع المخدوم العلائي المشار اليه اسبغ الله ظلاله بما سأله وبعد ذلك سال المملوك نظير ذلك فرفع ببعض القصد وكان معذورا ولم يسلم المملوك بالعذر الا فيما بعد فكتبت له على سبيل الانبساط وادلال العبودية على احسانه ومكارم اخلاقه ('Amin al-Din wrote a petition and the master al-'Ala'i granted what he asked; then the mamluk asked the like and received part of it ...; so I wrote to him in a familiar tone'). No solver line; ومما at the end of 83v l.7 introduces the text.

plaintext.text: يا ليتني اشبه المزي امين الدين لما لحظته بعينك بالرضا واللين / قد نال ما ساله في غاية التمكين الى اليمن فلك قوي عزمي واما الصين
plaintext.folio_lines: 83v l.8-10 (واللين written small above the left end of l.9 as the end of l.8; عزمي واما الصين on the short l.10)
plaintext.certainty: high; المزي as written; قد نال (the draft read فداك)

fit_check: fits: 100 signs vs 101 letters; 24 groups vs 25 words. Group by group equal (2,5,4,5,4,5,[8 = لما لحظته, no divider],5,6,6,2,3,2,4,2,4,7,3,5,[2 for فلك],3,4,4,5): the only letter difference is فلك, 2 signs (the last sign of l.5 and the first of l.6) against 3 letters. The marginal واللين is needed for the count: the cipher's tenth and eleventh groups are بالرضا (6) and واللين (6).
notes: Prose in saj' rhyming in -in (الدين, اللين, التمكين, الصين), a petition in cipher to the master al-'Ala'i.

count_method: by eye on 1.1x crops of all six lines. 83v l.12: a paper crack crosses the first sign (E with a lozenge, counted as one sign = waw) and the last two; the segmenter splits off the first sign as a group of its own and drops one sign at the left (eye 12 against 10). 84r l.2 and l.4: the segmenter has one sign too many on each (eye 12, 12). Dividers: 83v l.12 3, l.13 3, 84r l.1 2, l.2 4, l.3 2, l.4 2 plus line-end ones where present.
style: Latin/Greek-capital-like signs: A with a loop (= alif), N (= nun), T (= ra), a 4/Я shape (= ta), I (= ya), K (= kaf), M (= mim), B (= ba), lambda (= lam), 3 (= ha), O (= sin), H (= dal), Pi, E with a lozenge (= waw); dividers a stroke with three dots above
technique_note: 83v l.11: وكتب له ايضا في ذلك ادلال المملوك الصادق المحبة على المالك [?] ('and he also wrote to him on that, the presumption of the mamluk true in love upon the master'). After the block 84r l.5: وارسلته وهو. 84r l.8-11 (Shihab al-Din's report that the master took it amiss, and the compiler's answer that he meant only ajnas, craft and familiarity) comments on it.

plaintext.text: وكنت اظن اني بانتماي اليك انال ملا الراحتين / وما ذنبي سوى حبي رضاكم فقلنا [?] الياس احدى [?] الراحتين
plaintext.certainty: medium-high: فقلنا could be read فقلت + the alif of الياس (the cipher has a 4-sign فقلت); احدى is written with a joined first stroke (احدى/لحدي)

fit_check: signs < letters (72 vs 76, ratio 0.95); 17 groups vs 17 words, group by group equal for وكنت اظن اني بانتماي اليك انال (4,3,3,7,4,4), الراحتين (8), وما (3, over the line end), ذنبي سوى حبي (4,3,3), الياس (5), الراحتين (8). Cipher forms one letter shorter: ملا as مل (2), رضاكم as 4 (no sign for dad between ra and alif), فقلنا as فقلت (4: the fourth sign is the ta-sign of وكنت, بانتماي, الراحتين), احدى as حدى (3). Sign values agree throughout (A = alif, N = nun, I = ya, K = kaf in وكنت and اليك, T = ra in الراحتين twice and رضاكم).
notes: Crack across 83v l.12-13. The proverb اليأس احدى الراحتين ends the second verse.

count_method: by eye on 0.9-1x crops of every line. Counted: single signs written apart at the left edge of 84v l.1 (m-shape), l.4 (U) and l.5 (an arrow-cup): they are the last letters of words run over the line end, and the group pattern needs them. Not counted: two marks in the left margin beside 84r l.12 (a box and a small curl), outside the line's final divider. The triple comb (84v l.4, twice) is one sign. Segmenter differences: 84v l.4 and l.5 one sign too many each (comb split, a missed divider on l.5), l.6 the Arabic وهو taken for signs and one sign split (eye 10 against 14).
style: boxy signs: boxes with bars (⊟, ⊕), H, U-cups, a cup on a stem (Ф-like), a slashed hook, m-shape, Λ, T, a pin, a triple comb (three small combs on a base), an arrow-cup; dividers a stroke with three dots above
technique_note: 84r l.8-11: ذكر الشيخ شهاب الدين ان المخدوم حصل له ابراغ [?] وقال رضانا يبغي ان لا يحصل له شي قال فقلت له والله ما قصد الا الاجناس والصنعة والانبساط فقال صدقت وتبسم وكتبت له في ذلك حتى اطلعه [?] بنشرح وعلم ان القصد الانبساط لا غير ('Shihab al-Din reported that the master was displeased ...; I said: by God he meant only paronomasia, craft and familiarity; he said: you are right, and smiled. And I wrote to him about that ... so that he knew the intent was familiarity only'). 84v l.6 ends وهو.

plaintext.text: حلمك وجودك ويمنك [?] في النهى مشهور ومن يلذ / بجنابك لم يزل منصور / اني تركت قلبي سيدي مكسور طلبت منك جميل / ما اعطيتني عصفور
plaintext.folio_lines: 84v l.7-10 (l.8 and l.10 short; the alif of اني stands in the right margin of l.9)
plaintext.certainty: medium-high: the third word (ويمنك or وبينك) doubtful; the rest clear; a colloquial, zajal-like register (مكسور, جميل, عصفور without case endings)
